summary: Orbital Vitals is a health monitoring app that astronauts can use to keep track of their exercising, sleeping, and eating schedules. In space astronauts may face various threats such as radiation, rapidly changing temperatures, and psychological and physical challenges. Throughout astronauts' adventures to answer our questions about space and reality itself, we developed an app that makes it easier to keep themselves fit and healthy.
details: Orbital Vitals is a health monitoring app which astronauts can use to keep the track of their exercising, sleeping, and eating shedule. This app is quite useful for astronauts, who is always busy and forget daily routine activities easily. We used Java in front-end, Python in back-end and rest-api to connect these languages. Altough our team had a really hard time, we managed to get over it.
